minutes.headline: Planning Board agreed to claim the Stone Farm subdivision bond on October 14 if the work is still unfinished.
minutes.summary: The board heard an ANR plan for 190 Electric Avenue and held a public hearing on the Stone Farm Estates subdivision surety. It also discussed an economic development committee, the solar bylaw, a building committee appointment, and a joint hearing with the Selectmen. The ANR was held for plan corrections, and the committee and solar items were put off until an absent member returns.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board agreed to claim the Stone Farm Estates subdivision bond on October 14 if the unfinished work is not completed by then.
The board closed the public hearing on the Stone Farm surety after a resident said the bond may be inadequate for the outstanding work.
The ANR plan for 190 Electric Avenue was held for corrections; a special meeting is to be posted for Thursday to endorse the corrected plan.
The economic development committee draft, the solar bylaw and the TC Passios building committee appointment were put off, the first and last to September 9.
The board plans to post a meeting for the 24th to attend the Selectmen's meeting on the scenic road hearing.

why_it_matters: The surety bond is the town's guarantee that unfinished subdivision roads and utilities get built, so whether it covers the real cost decides if the town or the developer pays for any shortfall.
The TC Passios engineering study, funded at Town Meeting, could lead to a later vote on a combined town office, school office and studio building.
